description: This file defines the GrainInterfaceType struct and related classes/interfaces for identifying grain interfaces within the Orleans framework. It includes methods for creating, comparing, and formatting GrainInterfaceType instances, as well as attributes and providers for associating interface types with identifiers.

classes.name: GrainInterfaceType
classes.description: A readonly struct that uniquely identifies a grain interface within Orleans, supporting equality, formatting, and creation from strings or IdSpan.

classes.name: IGrainInterfaceTypeProvider
classes.description: An interface for retrieving a GrainInterfaceType from a given Type.

classes.name: AttributeGrainInterfaceTypeProvider
classes.description: A class that implements IGrainInterfaceTypeProvider, retrieving GrainInterfaceType based on custom attributes.

classes.name: IGrainInterfaceTypeProviderAttribute
classes.description: An attribute interface for specifying GrainInterfaceType on interfaces.

classes.name: GrainInterfaceTypeAttribute
classes.description: An attribute that, when applied to an interface, specifies its GrainInterfaceType.

methods.name: GrainInterfaceType.Create
methods.description: Creates a new GrainInterfaceType instance from a string value.

methods.name: GrainInterfaceType.Equals
methods.description: Checks equality between two GrainInterfaceType instances.

methods.name: GrainInterfaceType.GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code for the GrainInterfaceType instance.

methods.name: GrainInterfaceType.ToString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the underlying IdSpan.

methods.name: IGrainInterfaceTypeProvider.TryGetGrainInterfaceType
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a GrainInterfaceType for a given Type.

methods.name: AttributeGrainInterfaceTypeProvider.TryGetGrainInterfaceType
methods.description: Implements the interface method to get GrainInterfaceType based on attributes.

methods.name: GrainInterfaceTypeAttribute.GetGrainInterfaceType
methods.description: Returns the GrainInterfaceType associated with this attribute.
